title: Minneapolis Skyway Afternoon Snacks
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the unique culinary landscape of Minneapolis on this guided walking food tour through the interconnected Skyway system. Over two hours, sample four distinct local dishes that showcase the flavors of Minneapolis and the Midwest. While navigating through the climate-controlled passages, discover the historical significance of the Skyway that has linked generations for over sixty years. Follow your local guide though the maze of passages to the best hidden gems above, and below the streets of Minneapolis.

- Guided walking food tour through the Minneapolis Skyway system
- Taste four local dishes representative of Minneapolis and the Midwest
- Learn about the history and significance of the Skyway
- Easy 2-hour tour, perfect for food lovers and culture seekers alike
